name: stri_remove_empty_na
title: Remove empty strings and missing values

origin.description: Drops empty strings and missing values.
origin.details: Equivalent to stri_remove_empty(x, TRUE). stri_omit_empty_na is the same function. A blank space is kept.

translation.description: Drops empty strings and missing values.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A string, or a list of strings and stringi._na.NA.

translation.details: Calls stri_remove_empty with na_empty True. Both "" and NA are removed. A string of spaces is kept. stri_omit_empty_na is this function.
translation.value: A list of the kept strings.
translation.example:
from stringi._na import NA
from stringi.utils import stri_remove_empty_na
print(stri_remove_empty_na(['a', NA, '', 'b']))
